description: A preregistered finite census of tree and hierarchical algorithm families. Names and minor variants are collapsed when they imply the same observable behavior. TESTABLE means that the processed snapshot can screen a predictive fingerprint, not that it can identify a biological implementation.

status_definitions.TESTABLE: The snapshot can support a held-out predictive screen of the defining fingerprint.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Only a proxy can be screened because at least one defining observation is absent.
status_definitions.UNAVAILABLE: The observations required to distinguish the family are absent.

families.observable_fingerprint: One continuous history-dependent vector field predicts the next latent state without discrete routing.
families.required_observations: Current and past latent states with held-out successors.

families.observable_fingerprint: Hard axis-aligned thresholds route a trajectory to leaves with constant or local linear successor laws.
families.required_observations: Repeated crossings of candidate thresholds and enough held-out samples per leaf.

families.observable_fingerprint: Hard boundaries depend on combinations of latent coordinates rather than one coordinate.
families.required_observations: Train-only latent coordinates and repeated samples near multivariate boundaries.

families.observable_fingerprint: Routing probability changes smoothly near a boundary and approaches one branch away from it.
families.required_observations: Repeated trials sufficient to calibrate held-out routing probabilities.

families.observable_fingerprint: A coarse gate selects a context and lower gates select specialized local experts.
families.required_observations: Nested held-out routing with a flat-mixture capacity control.

families.observable_fingerprint: A continuous trajectory switches among a small number of local vector fields, optionally as a function of the current state.
families.required_observations: Repeated regimes and a same-capacity continuous dynamics baseline.

families.observable_fingerprint: Coarse parent dynamics are refined by smaller child residuals at increasing tree depth.
families.required_observations: Repeated trajectories at several scales and a flat rSLDS with matched capacity.

families.observable_fingerprint: Only a root-to-leaf subset is active, so active computation scales with path depth rather than total capacity.
families.required_observations: Simultaneous multi-area activity, causal latency, energy, active fraction, and branch perturbation.

families.observable_fingerprint: Observations occupy a few regimes and older history adds little once the current regime is known.
families.required_observations: Multiple independent sequences with repeated state-specific emissions.

families.observable_fingerprint: Exit probability depends on elapsed dwell time and repeated chunks have non-geometric durations.
families.required_observations: Many complete episodes with diverse durations and non-event-locked controls.

families.observable_fingerprint: A parent remains active while a child sequence completes, after which the parent transitions.
families.required_observations: Long variable-length sequences with recurring boundaries and multiple nesting depths.

families.observable_fingerprint: The useful history length varies by context; some suffixes need one step and others need deeper memory.
families.required_observations: Discretized trajectories long enough to compare suffix depths on held-out trials.

families.observable_fingerprint: An initiation set starts a temporally extended policy and a termination event returns control to the parent.
families.required_observations: Actions, state, reward or goal, initiation, termination, and long behavioral trajectories.

families.observable_fingerprint: Root ticks and Sequence or Fallback nodes generate retries, preemption, and Success, Failure, or Running outcomes.
families.required_observations: Conditions, actions, success, failure, running state, and failure trials.

families.observable_fingerprint: A non-primitive goal is repeatedly decomposed into reusable subtasks and primitive actions.
families.required_observations: Goals, world state, alternative decompositions, plans, and primitive actions.

families.observable_fingerprint: Nested calls return in LIFO order to suspended continuations and generalize beyond trained depth.
families.required_observations: Variable nesting depth, long traces, resume state, and call or return intervention.

families.observable_fingerprint: Held-out pairwise relations obey stable ultrametric or tree-metric constraints and predict where a new leaf attaches.
families.required_observations: At least four comparable tasks or states with independent repeats and a held-out leaf.

families.observable_fingerprint: Simultaneous variables have a stable conditional-dependence tree that improves held-out likelihood.
families.required_observations: Truly simultaneous neurons and intact trial-by-trial noise correlations.
